{"consolidated_memory":"**Blank Render Issues in ui/components/DataTable.tsx (Three Separate Occasions)**

All three occasions share the same symptom and file, but have different root causes, triggers, and fixes.

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-20] Race Condition on Same Key**
- File: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side)
- Problem: blank render in data table
- Repro: open table with saved column layout
- Trigger: manifested only when two requests raced on the same key
- Signal: empty tbody with no console error
- Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #2637 on branch fix/blank-render-1
- Result: flaky test went from 90 failures per hundred runs to zero
- Context note: same corner of ui/components/DataTable.tsx as earlier blank render work, so context carried over

---

**OCCASION 2: [2026-03-08] Negative UTC Offset**
- File: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side)
- Problem: blank render in data table
- Repro: open table with saved column layout
- Trigger: manifested only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Signal: empty tbody with no console error
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #4917 on branch fix/blank-render-2
- Result: backlog cleared 37 minutes after the deploy
- Stack: TypeScript
- Test coverage: ui/components/DataTable.test.tsx

---

**OCCASION 3: [2026-03-20] Large Payloads (>2MB)**
- File: ui/components/DataTable.tsx (web ui side)
- Problem: blank render in data table
- Repro: open table with saved column layout
- Trigger: manifested only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: empty tbody with no console error
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #5058 on branch fix/blank-render-3
- Result: p99 latency fell from 6.5 s to 955 ms
- Context note: same corner of ui/components/DataTable.tsx as earlier blank render work, so context carried over"}
